warnings: RC gable frame of the end walls, drawn along the y axis (bottom chain 2.50 | 3.25 | 3.50 | 3.25 | 2.50 = rows A'-A-B-C-D-D'''). It explains the stacked plan labels of the roof beam plan: each 'R2/R2' is an inclined R2 rafter beam above a horizontal R2 at the wall-top level on the same plan line; 'R3' is the small ridge-vent roof beam; R5 / R6 are the joints at the column lines; R4 is the triangular eave fin. Member sizes of R2 / R5 / R6 are on the sheet-5 sections and are not repeated here.

Only R4 and the small RC posts under the ridge-vent roof carry their own rebar callouts in this view. Level label 'ระดับใต้โครงหลังคาเหล็ก' is printed without a number and is not added to the z master.

The ridge-vent cap chain 0.90 | 1.25 | 1.25 | 0.90 (first value printed faintly, reads like 0.80; the four sum to 4.30 = the 2.15 + 2.15 printed over the ridge on sheet 2) is kept with the grid master's unassigned dimensions as an element-internal size of the ridge-vent roof.
